title: Method of Evaluation
text: A grading system will be established by the instructor and implemented uniformly. Grades will be based on demonstrated proficiency in subject matter determined by multiple measurements for evaluation, one of which must be essay exams, skills demonstration or, where appropriate, the symbol system.
items: Practical programming examinations requiring the design, implementation, testing, and debugging of programs.
Programming projects demonstrating the application of software development principles and programming techniques.
Problem-solving, program design, and code analysis assignments.
